grammar.explanation: 拿…来说 limits the next statement to an example. One example illustrates an account; it does not by itself establish a rule about everyone.

examples.zh: 拿第一次来说，那天一共六个人。
examples.py: ná dì yī cì lái shuō , nà tiān yī gòng liù gè rén .
examples.en: Take the first meeting: six people came.

examples.zh: 拿我来说，先听一会儿比较容易开口。
examples.py: ná wǒ lái shuō , xiān tīng yī huì er bǐ jiào róng yì kāi kǒu .
examples.en: For me, listening first makes speaking easier.

commonMistakes.wrong: 拿我来说，所以每个人都一定一样。
commonMistakes.right: 拿我来说，先听一会儿比较容易开口。
commonMistakes.why: An example about oneself does not justify a universal conclusion.

grammar.purpose: Keep a qualification in the answer
grammar.explanation: 尽管 acknowledges a real obstacle or contrasting fact; the second clause states the action despite it.

examples.zh: 尽管人数多了，我们还是要问大家的感受。
examples.py: jǐn guǎn rén shù duō le , wǒ men hái shi yào wèn dà jiā de gǎn shòu .
examples.en: Despite higher attendance, we still need to ask people how it felt.

examples.zh: 尽管这本没读完，我还是想来听。
examples.py: jǐn guǎn zhè běn méi dú wán , wǒ hái shi xiǎng lái tīng .
examples.en: Although I haven’t finished this book, I still want to come and listen.

commonMistakes.wrong: 尽管这本没读完，所以我已经读完了。
commonMistakes.right: 尽管这本没读完，我还是想来听。
commonMistakes.why: The second clause does not erase the acknowledged fact.

grammar.purpose: Attribute a judgment to its holder
grammar.explanation: 在…看来 marks whose view is being described. It is an attribution, not automatic agreement or independent proof.

examples.zh: 在她看来，安静不一定是没兴趣。
examples.py: zài tā kàn lái , ān jìng bù yí dìng shì méi xìng qù .
examples.en: In her view, silence does not necessarily mean no interest.

examples.zh: 在我看来，先读再聊比较合适。
examples.py: zài wǒ kàn lái , xiān dú zài liáo bǐ jiào hé shì .
examples.en: In my view, reading before talking works better.

commonMistakes.wrong: 在她看来，就证明所有人都同意。
commonMistakes.right: 在她看来，安静不一定是没兴趣。
commonMistakes.why: A stated view is not evidence of everyone’s agreement.

grammar.purpose: State a limit on the basis for judgment
grammar.explanation: 凭 introduces a basis. 只 narrows that basis; 难以 signals difficulty rather than absolute impossibility.

examples.zh: 只凭一次到场，难以判断以后会不会再来。
examples.py: zhǐ píng yī cì dào chǎng , nán yǐ pàn duàn yǐ hòu huì bù huì zài lái .
examples.en: Attendance once is insufficient to judge whether someone will return.

examples.zh: 只凭人数，难以知道大家喜欢什么。
examples.py: zhǐ píng rén shù , nán yǐ zhī dào dà jiā xǐ huān shén me .
examples.en: Numbers alone make it hard to know what people like.

commonMistakes.wrong: 只凭人数，就知道每个人为什么来。
commonMistakes.right: 只凭人数，难以知道大家喜欢什么。
commonMistakes.why: A count does not state each participant’s reasons.

grammar.purpose: Order preparation and a later choice
grammar.explanation: The sequence can let the second action depend on what the speaker learns in the first. It need not require both to happen immediately.

examples.zh: 我想先听，再决定要不要说。
examples.py: wǒ xiǎng xiān tīng , zài jué dìng yào bù yào shuō .
examples.en: I want to listen first and then decide whether to speak.

examples.zh: 先确认小厅，再联络报名的人。
examples.py: xiān què rèn xiǎo tīng , zài lián luò bào míng de rén .
examples.en: Confirm the hall first, then contact registered people.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我想先听，再决定，所以已经决定必须说。
commonMistakes.right: 我想先听，再决定要不要说。
commonMistakes.why: An open later decision is not a prior commitment to speak.

lines.zh: 你怎么开始办这个读书小组的？
lines.py: nǐ zěn me kāi shǐ bàn zhè gè dú shū xiǎo zǔ de ?
lines.en: How did you start this reading group?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我偶然在社区见到一位朋友，她问有没有地方一起读。
lines.py: wǒ ǒu rán zài shè qū jiàn dào yī wèi péng you , tā wèn yǒu méi yǒu dì fāng yì qǐ dú .
lines.en: I happened to meet a friend in the community who asked about a place to read together.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 所以一开始就决定每周办？
lines.py: suǒ yǐ yī kāi shǐ jiù jué dìng měi zhōu bàn ?
lines.en: So you decided straight away to run it every week?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 没有，先试六周。第一次六个人，上周十个人。
lines.py: méi yǒu , xiān shì liù zhōu . dì yī cì liù gè rén , shàng zhōu shí gè rén .
lines.en: No, we started with a six-week trial. Six people came first time, ten last week.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 人数多了，是不是大家都更喜欢了？
lines.py: rén shù duō le , shì bú shì dà jiā dōu gèng xǐ huān le ?
lines.en: Does growing attendance mean everyone likes it more?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 有的人是朋友带来的，我还不知道他们会不会再来。
lines.py: yǒu de rén shì péng you dài lái de , wǒ hái bù zhī dào tā men huì bù huì zài lái .
lines.en: Some were brought by friends. I don’t know yet whether they will return.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你自己最难的是什么？
lines.py: nǐ zì jǐ zuì nán de shì shén me ?
lines.en: What is hardest for you personally?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 安排谁先说。我以前觉得，安静就说明没人想说。
lines.py: ān pái shéi xiān shuō . wǒ yǐ qián jué de , ān jìng jiù shuō míng méi rén xiǎng shuō .
lines.en: Arranging who speaks first. I used to think silence meant no one wanted to talk.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 现在不这样看待了？
lines.py: xiàn zài bù zhè yàng kàn dài le ?
lines.en: You don’t see it that way now?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。有个人第二次才告诉我，他第一次是在认真听。
lines.py: duì . yǒu gè rén dì èr cì cái gào sù wǒ , tā dì yī cì shì zài rèn zhēn tīng .
lines.en: Right. One person told me on his second visit that he’d been listening carefully on the first.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 后来怎么安排？
lines.py: hòu lái zěn me ān pái ?
lines.en: How did you organise it after that?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 先读半小时，再交流半小时。想说的先说，不想说的可以听。
lines.py: xiān dú bàn xiǎo shí , zài jiāo liú bàn xiǎo shí . xiǎng shuō de xiān shuō , bù xiǎng shuō de kě yǐ tīng .
lines.en: Read for half an hour, then discuss for half an hour. Those who want to speak can; others can listen.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 这样是不是就没有压力了？
lines.py: zhè yàng shì bú shì jiù méi yǒu yā lì le ?
lines.en: Does that remove all the pressure?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 也不能这么说。有人还是怕讲错，我会先问他想不想说一句。
lines.py: yě bù néng zhè me shuō . yǒu rén hái shi pà jiǎng cuò , wǒ huì xiān wèn tā xiǎng bù xiǎng shuō yī jù .
lines.en: Not necessarily. Some still fear mistakes; I ask whether they’d like to start with one sentence.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 年龄不同，会不会很难聊到一起？
lines.py: nián líng bù tóng , huì bù huì hěn nán liáo dào yì qǐ ?
lines.en: Does the age difference make it hard to find common ground?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 有时喜欢的书不同，但同一本书也会有不同看法。
lines.py: yǒu shí xǐ huān de shū bù tóng , dàn tóng yī běn shū yě huì yǒu bù tóng kàn fǎ .
lines.en: Sometimes book preferences differ, but even one book can bring different views.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 接下来你最想改什么？
lines.py: jiē xià lái nǐ zuì xiǎng gǎi shén me ?
lines.en: What do you most want to change next?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 通知别太频繁。一周发一次，改时间再单独联络。
lines.py: tōng zhī bié tài pín fán . yī zhōu fā yī cì , gǎi shí jiān zài dān dú lián luò .
lines.en: Make notifications less frequent: once a week, with separate contact if the time changes.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 社区的读书小组试办了六周以后，我去采访负责联络的林安。小厅里的书柜没有很特别的安排，椅子围着一张桌子，也没有讲台。我原来以为，她会先告诉我多少人报名、以后准备办多大。她却拿出一封来信，说这个人第二次来以后才写，想问下次能不能先听，再决定自己要不要说。
lines.py: shè qū de dú shū xiǎo zǔ shì bàn le liù zhōu yǐ hòu , wǒ qù cǎi fǎng fù zé lián luò de lín ān . xiǎo tīng lǐ de shū guì méi yǒu hěn tè bié de ān pái , yǐ zi wéi zhe yī zhāng zhuō zi , yě méi yǒu jiǎng tái . wǒ yuán lái yǐ wéi , tā huì xiān gào sù wǒ duō shao rén bào míng , yǐ hòu zhǔn bèi bàn duō dà . tā què ná chū yī fēng lái xìn , shuō zhè gè rén dì èr cì lái yǐ hòu cái xiě , xiǎng wèn xià cì néng bù néng xiān tīng , zài jué dìng zì jǐ yào bù yào shuō .
lines.en: After the community reading group’s six-week trial, I interviewed Lin An, who handles contact. A bookcase and chairs around a table replaced any special equipment or lectern. I expected registration totals and expansion plans; instead she showed a letter from a second-time visitor asking to listen first and decide later whether to speak.

lines.zh: 我问她为什么在意这个问题。她说，第一次活动有六个人，有一段时间大家都安静，她以为准备得不好，就急着一直说。后来其中一个人告诉她，他不是没有兴趣，而是在听别人怎么谈这本书。这个例子使她改变了对安静的看法，但她也说，不能因此认定每个安静的人都一样，有的人可能真的不喜欢。
lines.py: wǒ wèn tā wèi shén me zài yì zhè gè wèn tí . tā shuō , dì yī cì huó dòng yǒu liù gè rén , yǒu yī duàn shí jiān dà jiā dōu ān jìng , tā yǐ wéi zhǔn bèi de bù hǎo , jiù jí zhe yì zhí shuō . hòu lái qí zhōng yī gè rén gào sù tā , tā bù shì méi yǒu xìng qù , ér shì zài tīng bié ren zěn me tán zhè běn shū . zhè gè lì zi shǐ tā gǎi biàn le duì ān jìng de kàn fǎ , dàn tā yě shuō , bù néng yīn cǐ rèn dìng měi gè ān jìng de rén dōu yī yàng , yǒu de rén kě néng zhēn de bù xǐ huān .
lines.en: I asked why it mattered. At the first six-person meeting silence made her think she’d prepared poorly, so she filled it by talking. One participant later explained that he was listening to how others discussed the book. This changed her view of silence, though she didn’t assume all quiet people were alike: some might genuinely dislike the event.

lines.zh: 活动现在先读半小时，再交流半小时，加上一点开始前的整理，负责的人会早点来。对于参加者，正式安排仍然是一个小时。想说的人先说，暂时不想说的可以听；如果有人愿意说一句，她就给他留一点时间，不要求一次把全部感受讲完。这个办法减轻了一些人的压力，也需要她学会等，不是把所有空处马上填满。
lines.py: huó dòng xiàn zài xiān dú bàn xiǎo shí , zài jiāo liú bàn xiǎo shí , jiā shàng yī diǎn kāi shǐ qián de zhěng lǐ , fù zé de rén huì zǎo diǎn lái . duì yú cān jiā zhě , zhèng shì ān pái réng rán shì yī gè xiǎo shí . xiǎng shuō de rén xiān shuō , zàn shí bù xiǎng shuō de kě yǐ tīng ; rú guǒ yǒu rén yuàn yì shuō yī jù , tā jiù gěi tā liú yī diǎn shí jiān , bú yào qiú yī cì bǎ quán bù gǎn shòu jiǎng wán . zhè gè bàn fǎ jiǎn qīng le yī xiē rén de yā lì , yě xū yào tā xué huì děng , bù shì bǎ suǒ yǒu kōng chù mǎ shàng tián mǎn .
lines.en: Participants read for half an hour and discuss for half an hour. Organisers arrive earlier for preparation, but the formal session remains one hour. Speakers can go first and others listen; someone willing to say one sentence gets time without needing a complete account. This eases some pressure and requires her to wait instead of filling every gap.

lines.zh: 我听她说上周有十个人，就问人数增加是不是说明办法一定有效。她没有直接答应这个判断。上周有两个人是朋友带来的，有的人只是偶尔来，她还不知道以后会不会保持这个人数。她认为，人数可以记，但来的人有没有找到想读的内容、日期是不是合适，也要问清楚。十个人到场，不能替十个人回答所有问题。
lines.py: wǒ tīng tā shuō shàng zhōu yǒu shí gè rén , jiù wèn rén shù zēng jiā shì bú shì shuō míng bàn fǎ yí dìng yǒu xiào . tā méi yǒu zhí jiē dā yìng zhè gè pàn duàn . shàng zhōu yǒu liǎng gè rén shì péng you dài lái de , yǒu de rén zhǐ shì ǒu ěr lái , tā hái bù zhī dào yǐ hòu huì bù huì bǎo chí zhè gè rén shù . tā rèn wéi , rén shù kě yǐ jì , dàn lái de rén yǒu méi yǒu zhǎo dào xiǎng dú de nèi róng , rì qī shì bú shì hé shì , yě yào wèn qīng chǔ . shí gè rén dào chǎng , bù néng tì shí gè rén huí dá suǒ yǒu wèn tí .
lines.en: When she said ten attended last week, I asked whether this proved the approach worked. She qualified that: two had come with friends, some attended only occasionally, and future numbers were unknown. Counts mattered alongside interests and scheduling. Ten people’s presence couldn’t answer every question on their behalf.

lines.zh: 我又问年龄会不会影响交流。她说有时候选书会不同，不过同样年龄的人也不一定喜欢同一种故事。一次较年轻的参加者想知道角色为什么不直接道歉，另一位年长的朋友说自己年轻时也不愿先开口。他们并没有马上同意，但后来各自找出一段支持自己的看法，比只说“你们这个年龄都这样”更能继续聊。
lines.py: wǒ yòu wèn nián líng huì bù huì yǐng xiǎng jiāo liú . tā shuō yǒu shí hou xuǎn shū huì bù tóng , bù guò tóng yàng nián líng de rén yě bù yí dìng xǐ huān tóng yī zhǒng gù shì . yī cì jiào nián qīng de cān jiā zhě xiǎng zhī dào jué sè wèi shén me bù zhí jiē dào qiàn , lìng yī wèi nián zhǎng de péng you shuō zì jǐ nián qīng shí yě bù yuàn xiān kāi kǒu . tā men bìng méi yǒu mǎ shàng tóng yì , dàn hòu lái gè zì zhǎo chū yī duàn zhī chí zì jǐ de kàn fǎ , bǐ zhǐ shuō nǐ men zhè gè nián líng dōu zhè yàng gèng néng jì xù liáo .
lines.en: She said age sometimes affected book choice, but people of the same age could have different preferences. A younger reader questioned a character’s failure to apologise; an older reader recalled not wanting to speak first when young. They didn’t instantly agree but found passages supporting their views, which kept discussion going better than generalisations about age.

lines.zh: 接下来，她想改的是通知。我听见“联络更方便”，以为要发更多消息，她说正好相反。近来日期、书名、准备事项分开发，有人找不到最重要的一条。她准备一周发一次完整安排，如果时间更换，再单独通知。少发并不等于不联络，而是让同一个人不用在几条消息里来回找。
lines.py: jiē xià lái , tā xiǎng gǎi de shì tōng zhī . wǒ tīng jiàn lián luò gèng fāng biàn , yǐ wéi yào fā gèng duō xiāo xī , tā shuō zhèng hǎo xiāng fǎn . jìn lái rì qī , shū míng , zhǔn bèi shì xiàng fēn kāi fā , yǒu rén zhǎo bù dào zuì zhòng yào de yī tiáo . tā zhǔn bèi yī zhōu fā yī cì wán zhěng ān pái , rú guǒ shí jiān gēng huàn , zài dān dú tōng zhī . shǎo fā bìng bù děng yú bù lián luò , ér shì ràng tóng yī gè rén bù yòng zài jǐ tiáo xiāo xī lǐ lái huí zhǎo .
lines.en: Her next change concerned notices. I assumed easier contact meant more messages; she meant the opposite. Dates, titles and preparations had been sent separately, obscuring the key information. One weekly complete schedule plus separate updates for changed times would reduce searching without ending contact.

lines.zh: 采访快结束，我问她是不是很有信心一直办下去。她说想继续，但要先确认下个月的小厅和自己的时间。她说得很坚定，却没有保证每次都有十个人，也没有说所有人都会爱上读书。她希望以后有人愿意帮一次联络，自己也能坐下来读，不必每周只顾着安排别人怎么说。
lines.py: cǎi fǎng kuài jié shù , wǒ wèn tā shì bú shì hěn yǒu xìn xīn yì zhí bàn xià qù . tā shuō xiǎng jì xù , dàn yào xiān què rèn xià gè yuè de xiǎo tīng hé zì jǐ de shí jiān . tā shuō de hěn jiān dìng , què méi yǒu bǎo zhèng měi cì dōu yǒu shí gè rén , yě méi yǒu shuō suǒ yǒu rén dū huì ài shàng dú shū . tā xī wàng yǐ hòu yǒu rén yuàn yì bāng yī cì lián luò , zì jǐ yě néng zuò xià lái dú , bù bì měi zhōu zhǐ gù zhe ān pái bié ren zěn me shuō .
lines.en: At the end she wanted to continue but needed to check next month’s venue and availability. She was firm without guaranteeing ten attendees or universal enthusiasm. She hoped someone might help with contact occasionally, allowing her to read rather than only organise others’ speech.

lines.zh: 回去整理采访时，我没有把标题写成“一个办法让所有人开口”。她讲的是一次试办中的具体变化，还有不知道的地方。她的例子让我受到启发：听一个人的经验，既可以了解她怎么做，也要听她把话说到哪里为止。保留这些限制，不会让她的经验变得没用，反而让我知道自己可以试什么，又不能直接断定什么。
lines.py: huí qù zhěng lǐ cǎi fǎng shí , wǒ méi yǒu bǎ biāo tí xiě chéng yī gè bàn fǎ ràng suǒ yǒu rén kāi kǒu . tā jiǎng de shì yī cì shì bàn zhōng de jù tǐ biàn huà , hái yǒu bù zhī dào de dì fāng . tā de lì zi ràng wǒ shòu dào qǐ fā : tīng yī gè rén de jīng yàn , jì kě yǐ liǎo jiě tā zěn me zuò , yě yào tīng tā bǎ huà shuō dào nǎ lǐ wéi zhǐ . bǎo liú zhè xiē xiàn zhì , bù huì ràng tā de jīng yàn biàn de méi yòng , fǎn ér ràng wǒ zhī dào zì jǐ kě yǐ shì shén me , yòu bù néng zhí jiē duàn dìng shén me .
lines.en: I avoided a headline claiming one method made everyone speak. She described particular changes in a trial and remaining unknowns. Her examples suggested listening both to what someone did and where they limited their claims. Keeping those limits made the experience useful by distinguishing possibilities to try from conclusions not yet justified.

choices: Keep the examples and qualifications together
Replace every qualification with a dramatic claim
Attendance proves universal enthusiasm
questions.answer: Keep the examples and qualifications together

choices: One complete weekly message, plus separate time changes
No more contact under any circumstances
An individual reminder at every hour
questions.answer: One complete weekly message, plus separate time changes

questions.q: Why avoid the headline about making everyone speak?
choices: The account does not establish that universal result
The interview contained no examples
The group requires everyone to give a speech
questions.answer: The account does not establish that universal result

extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.

lines.zh: 你怎么抱着三本来？
lines.py: nǐ zěn me bào zhe sān běn lái ?
lines.en: Why did you bring three books?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我以为只带一本，会显得我没准备。
lines.py: wǒ yǐ wéi zhǐ dài yī běn , huì xiǎn de wǒ méi zhǔn bèi .
lines.en: I thought one book might make me look unprepared.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天只讨论一本，另外两本先放包里吧。
lines.py: jīn tiān zhǐ tǎo lùn yī běn , lìng wài liǎng běn xiān fàng bāo lǐ ba .
lines.en: We discuss one today. Keep the other two in your bag for now.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那我为了看起来认真，多背了两本。
lines.py: nà wǒ wèi le kàn qǐ lái rèn zhēn , duō bèi le liǎng běn .
lines.en: Then I carried two extra just to look serious.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 你的肩比你的嘴先参加讨论了。
lines.py: nǐ de jiān bǐ nǐ de zuǐ xiān cān jiā tǎo lùn le .
lines.en: Your shoulders joined the discussion before your mouth.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 肩说，下次请提前讲清楚。
lines.py: jiān shuō , xià cì qǐng tí qián jiǎng qīng chǔ .
lines.en: My shoulders say: please explain that beforehand next time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 通知上写一本，你是不是只看了日期？
lines.py: tōng zhī shàng xiě yī běn , nǐ shì bú shì zhǐ kàn le rì qī ?
lines.en: The notice says one book. Did you only read the date?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 也看了地方，就是跳过了中间。
lines.py: yě kàn le dì fāng , jiù shì tiào guò le zhōng jiān .
lines.en: I read the place too, just skipped the middle.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 坐吧，先读半小时。
lines.py: zuò ba , xiān dú bàn xiǎo shí .
lines.en: Have a seat. We read for half an hour first.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我不一定会讲，先听可以吗？
lines.py: wǒ bù yí dìng huì jiǎng , xiān tīng kě yǐ ma ?
lines.en: I might not speak. Can I listen first?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 当然，书不用举着证明你来过。
lines.py: dāng rán , shū bù yòng jǔ zhe zhèng míng nǐ lái guò .
lines.en: Of course. No need to hold the book up to prove attendance.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 太好了，肩已经同意了。
lines.py: tài hǎo le , jiān yǐ jīng tóng yì le .
lines.en: Great. My shoulders have already agreed.
lines.speaker: b

choices: To appear prepared
The notice required three
Each participant had to lend three
Friendly teasing about carrying extra books
A literal speaking shoulder
A rule that listening is forbidden
questions.answer: Friendly teasing about carrying extra books

extraReadings.title: Listen to the whole answer: words in context
extraReadings.titleZh: 把回答听完整 · 词语练习
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Retrieve these words in separate everyday situations.

lines.zh: 我第一次接触这个读书小组，是朋友带我来的。
lines.py: wǒ dì yī cì jiē chù zhè gè dú shū xiǎo zǔ , shì péng you dài wǒ lái de .
lines.en: My first contact with this reading group was through a friend.

lines.zh: 她接触过几种不同的工作。
lines.py: tā jiē chù guò jǐ zhǒng bù tóng de gōng zuò .
lines.en: She has had contact with several kinds of work.

lines.zh: 这次见面是偶然的，我们没有提前约。
lines.py: zhè cì jiàn miàn shì ǒu rán de , wǒ men méi yǒu tí qián yuē .
lines.en: This meeting happened by chance; we hadn’t arranged it.

lines.zh: 他偶然发现书里夹着一封旧信。
lines.py: tā ǒu rán fā xiàn shū lǐ jiā zhe yī fēng jiù xìn .
lines.en: He happened to find an old letter inside the book.

lines.zh: 我偶尔来一次，不是每周都来。
lines.py: wǒ ǒu ěr lái yī cì , bù shì měi zhōu dōu lái .
lines.en: I come occasionally, not every week.

lines.zh: 她偶尔在家做面包。
lines.py: tā ǒu ěr zài jiā zuò miàn bāo .
lines.en: She occasionally makes bread at home.

lines.zh: 有人找不到页，我们耐心等他一下。
lines.py: yǒu rén zhǎo bù dào yè , wǒ men nài xīn děng tā yī xià .
lines.en: When someone cannot find the page, we patiently wait a moment.

lines.zh: 这件事需要耐心，今天做不完。
lines.py: zhè jiàn shì xū yào nài xīn , jīn tiān zuò bù wán .
lines.en: This needs patience; it won’t be finished today.

lines.zh: 人多以后，谁先说这个问题一直困扰我。
lines.py: rén duō yǐ hòu , shéi xiān shuō zhè gè wèn tí yì zhí kùn rǎo wǒ .
lines.en: As attendance grew, deciding who speaks first kept troubling me.

lines.zh: 门外的声音困扰了她好几天。
lines.py: mén wài de shēng yīn kùn rǎo le tā hǎo jǐ tiān .
lines.en: The noise outside bothered her for several days.

lines.zh: 你怎么看待有人只听不说？
lines.py: nǐ zěn me kàn dài yǒu rén zhǐ tīng bù shuō ?
lines.en: How do you view people who listen without speaking?

lines.zh: 同一件事，他们看待的方式不同。
lines.py: tóng yī jiàn shì , tā men kàn dài de fāng shì bù tóng .
lines.en: They view the same matter differently.

lines.zh: 安排大家轮流说，也是一种需要练习的技能。
lines.py: ān pái dà jiā lún liú shuō , yě shì yī zhǒng xū yào liàn xí de jì néng .
lines.en: Arranging turns is also a skill that needs practice.

lines.zh: 他正在学习修理自行车的技能。
lines.py: tā zhèng zài xué xí xiū lǐ zì xíng chē de jì néng .
lines.en: He is learning bicycle-repair skills.

lines.zh: 我们不按年龄决定谁先说。
lines.py: wǒ men bù àn nián líng jué dìng shéi xiān shuō .
lines.en: We do not decide speaking order by age.

lines.zh: 表上要写年龄，不是出生地。
lines.py: biǎo shàng yào xiě nián líng , bù shì chū shēng de .
lines.en: The form asks for age, not birthplace.

lines.zh: 日期变了，我会和报名的人联络。
lines.py: rì qī biàn le , wǒ huì hé bào míng de rén lián luò .
lines.en: If the date changes, I will contact the registered participants.

lines.zh: 换号码以后，记得和她联络。
lines.py: huàn hào mǎ yǐ hòu , jì de hé tā lián luò .
lines.en: Remember to contact her after changing your number.

lines.zh: 读半小时，加上交流半小时，一共一个小时。
lines.py: dú bàn xiǎo shí , jiā shàng jiāo liú bàn xiǎo shí , yī gòng yī gè xiǎo shí .
lines.en: Half an hour reading plus half an hour discussion totals one hour.

lines.zh: 两张票加上车费，超过了我的预算。
lines.py: liǎng zhāng piào jiā shàng chē fèi , chāo guò le wǒ de yù suàn .
lines.en: The two tickets plus travel cost exceed my budget.

lines.zh: 近来每次来的人比刚开始多。
lines.py: jìn lái měi cì lái de rén bǐ gāng kāi shǐ duō .
lines.en: Recently attendance has been higher than at the beginning.

lines.zh: 近来她常常早点下班。
lines.py: jìn lái tā cháng cháng zǎo diǎn xià bān .
lines.en: Recently she has often left work earlier.

lines.zh: 大家难得在同一天下午都有空。
lines.py: dà jiā nán dé zài tóng yī tiān xià wǔ dōu yǒu kōng .
lines.en: It is rare for everyone to be free on the same afternoon.

lines.zh: 难得来一次，我们慢慢逛。
lines.py: nán dé lái yī cì , wǒ men màn màn guàng .
lines.en: We rarely get to come here; let’s take our time looking around.

lines.zh: 只凭一次活动，难以判断以后会不会一直来。
lines.py: zhǐ píng yī cì huó dòng , nán yǐ pàn duàn yǐ hòu huì bù huì yì zhí lái .
lines.en: One visit alone makes it hard to judge whether someone will keep coming.

lines.zh: 门坏了，屋里的人难以出去。
lines.py: mén huài le , wū lǐ de rén nán yǐ chū qù .
lines.en: The broken door makes it difficult for those inside to get out.

lines.zh: 她很坚定地说，读不完也可以来。
lines.py: tā hěn jiān dìng de shuō , dú bù wán yě kě yǐ lái .
lines.en: She firmly said people could come without finishing the book.

lines.zh: 试过以后，他更坚定自己的选择。
lines.py: shì guò yǐ hòu , tā gèng jiān dìng zì jǐ de xuǎn zé .
lines.en: After trying it he was more certain of his choice.

lines.zh: 先说一句就行，这样能减轻一些压力。
lines.py: xiān shuō yī jù jiù xíng , zhè yàng néng jiǎn qīng yī xiē yā lì .
lines.en: Starting with one sentence can ease some pressure.

lines.zh: 把书分开拿，可以减轻每次的重量。
lines.py: bǎ shū fēn kāi ná , kě yǐ jiǎn qīng měi cì de zhòng liàng .
lines.en: Carrying the books separately reduces each load.

lines.zh: 那位只听的朋友，后来给了我一个启发。
lines.py: nà wèi zhǐ tīng de péng you , hòu lái gěi le wǒ yī gè qǐ fā .
lines.en: The friend who initially only listened later gave me an idea.

lines.zh: 她的问题启发我换一种做法。
lines.py: tā de wèn tí qǐ fā wǒ huàn yī zhǒng zuò fǎ .
lines.en: Her question inspired me to try a different approach.

lines.zh: 能参加的前提是有空，不是必须讲得好。
lines.py: néng cān jiā de qián tí shì yǒu kōng , bù shì bì xū jiǎng de hǎo .
lines.en: The prerequisite for attending is availability, not speaking well.

lines.zh: 我们同意帮忙，前提是先说清日期。
lines.py: wǒ men tóng yì bāng máng , qián tí shì xiān shuō qīng rì qī .
lines.en: We agree to help provided the date is clarified first.

lines.zh: 这个社区的小厅每周六下午可以用。
lines.py: zhè gè shè qū de xiǎo tīng měi zhōu liù xià wǔ kě yǐ yòng .
lines.en: This community’s small hall is available on Saturday afternoons.

lines.zh: 她在社区里认识了几个邻居。
lines.py: tā zài shè qū lǐ rèn shi le jǐ gè lín jū .
lines.en: She has met several neighbours in the community.

lines.zh: 活动以后，我收集大家想读的书名。
lines.py: huó dòng yǐ hòu , wǒ shōu jí dà jiā xiǎng dú de shū míng .
lines.en: After the event I collect titles people want to read.

lines.zh: 他收集了几张旧地图。
lines.py: tā shōu jí le jǐ zhāng jiù dì tú .
lines.en: He collected several old maps.

lines.zh: 我不太同意“没说话就是没参加”这个说法。
lines.py: wǒ bù tài tóng yì méi shuō huà jiù shì méi cān jiā zhè gè shuō fǎ .
lines.en: I disagree with the view that not speaking means not participating.

lines.zh: 两个人的说法不完全一样。
lines.py: liǎng gè rén de shuō fǎ bù wán quán yī yàng .
lines.en: The two accounts are not entirely the same.

lines.zh: 最近联络太频繁，有人希望只收一次通知。
lines.py: zuì jìn lián luò tài pín fán , yǒu rén xī wàng zhǐ shōu yī cì tōng zhī .
lines.en: Recent contact was too frequent; someone wanted just one notification.

lines.zh: 她不想频繁更换学习地点。
lines.py: tā bù xiǎng pín fán gēng huàn xué xí dì diǎn .
lines.en: She does not want to change study locations frequently.

lines.zh: 这本是入门的书，例子比较短。
lines.py: zhè běn shì rù mén de shū , lì zi bǐ jiào duǎn .
lines.en: This is an introductory book with fairly short examples.

lines.zh: 刚入门的时候，他每天只练十分钟。
lines.py: gāng rù mén de shí hou , tā měi tiān zhǐ liàn shí fēn zhōng .
lines.en: When starting out he practised only ten minutes a day.

lines.zh: 小厅里的书柜，不是所有书都可以借走。
lines.py: xiǎo tīng lǐ de shū guì , bù shì suǒ yǒu shū dōu kě yǐ jiè zǒu .
lines.en: Not every book in the hall’s bookcase can be borrowed.

lines.zh: 她把字典放回书柜最上面。
lines.py: tā bǎ zì diǎn fàng huí shū guì zuì shàng miàn .
lines.en: She put the dictionary back at the top of the bookcase.

lines.zh: 这封来信问，下次能不能先听再决定要不要说。
lines.py: zhè fēng lái xìn wèn , xià cì néng bù néng xiān tīng zài jué dìng yào bù yào shuō .
lines.en: This letter asks whether one can listen first and decide later whether to speak.

lines.zh: 他的来信里没有写新的地址。
lines.py: tā de lái xìn lǐ méi yǒu xiě xīn de dì zhǐ .
lines.en: His letter did not give the new address.

extraReadings.title: From a listener’s seat
extraReadings.blurb: An original learning text, not a published script or lyric.
extraReadings.purpose: Follow the speakers’ intentions, supporting details and outcome.

lines.zh: 我是在朋友带领下第一次接触这个读书小组的。那天下午六个人围着桌子坐，我带来一本书，却不想马上介绍。负责的人一见安静，就自己讲了很长一段。我没有觉得她讲得不好，只是在记谁读过哪些部分，也想听别人怎样说。我走的时候没有解释，所以她当时并不知道我安静的原因。
lines.py: wǒ shì zài péng you dài lǐng xià dì yī cì jiē chù zhè gè dú shū xiǎo zǔ de . nà tiān xià wǔ liù gè rén wéi zhe zhuō zi zuò , wǒ dài lái yī běn shū , què bù xiǎng mǎ shàng jiè shào . fù zé de rén yī jiàn ān jìng , jiù zì jǐ jiǎng le hěn zhǎng yī duàn . wǒ méi yǒu jué de tā jiǎng de bù hǎo , zhǐ shì zài jì shéi dú guò nǎ xiē bù fèn , yě xiǎng tīng bié ren zěn yàng shuō . wǒ zǒu de shí hou méi yǒu jiě shì , suǒ yǐ tā dāng shí bìng bù zhī dào wǒ ān jìng de yuán yīn .
lines.en: A friend brought me to the reading group. Six people sat around the table; I had a book but didn’t want to introduce it immediately. The organiser filled the silence with a long explanation. I was listening to others’ reading and ways of discussing it, not disliking her account, but didn’t explain before leaving.

lines.zh: 第二次来，我在门口告诉她，上次听得很认真。她问是不是不喜欢在人前说，我说有一点，不过也因为那本书还没读完。她没有让我下次先全部读完再来，而是说可以谈自己已经读到的地方。我后来写了一封来信，问能不能先听再决定，这样不用报名时就答应一定发言。
lines.py: dì èr cì lái , wǒ zài mén kǒu gào sù tā , shàng cì tīng de hěn rèn zhēn . tā wèn shì bú shì bù xǐ huān zài rén qián shuō , wǒ shuō yǒu yī diǎn , bù guò yě yīn wèi nà běn shū hái méi dú wán . tā méi yǒu ràng wǒ xià cì xiān quán bù dú wán zài lái , ér shì shuō kě yǐ tán zì jǐ yǐ jīng dú dào de dì fāng . wǒ hòu lái xiě le yī fēng lái xìn , wèn néng bù néng xiān tīng zài jué dìng , zhè yàng bù yòng bào míng shí jiù dā yìng yí dìng fā yán .
lines.en: At my second visit I explained that I’d listened carefully. I was somewhat nervous about speaking and also hadn’t finished the book. She invited discussion of what I’d read instead of requiring completion. I later wrote asking to decide about speaking after listening, rather than commit at registration.

lines.zh: 第三次的安排是先读半小时，再交流半小时。我坐在书柜旁边，读到一个角色回家以后又走的地方。她问谁想说，我没有举手；等别人讲完，我才说，自己不觉得他是不在意家里的人。我的一句话引来一个问题，我又找出前面的一小段给大家看。那次我并没有说很多，但比第一回更愿意接着聊。
lines.py: dì sān cì de ān pái shì xiān dú bàn xiǎo shí , zài jiāo liú bàn xiǎo shí . wǒ zuò zài shū guì páng biān , dú dào yī gè jué sè huí jiā yǐ hòu yòu zǒu de dì fāng . tā wèn shéi xiǎng shuō , wǒ méi yǒu jǔ shǒu ; děng bié ren jiǎng wán , wǒ cái shuō , zì jǐ bù jué de tā shì bù zài yì jiā lǐ de rén . wǒ de yī jù huà yǐn lái yī gè wèn tí , wǒ yòu zhǎo chū qián miàn de yī xiǎo duàn gěi dà jiā kàn . nà cì wǒ bìng méi yǒu shuō hěn duō , dàn bǐ dì yī huí gèng yuàn yì jiē zhe liáo .
lines.en: At the third session we read and discussed for half an hour each. A character’s departure after returning home interested me. I waited until others spoke, then suggested he wasn’t indifferent to his family. A question prompted me to point to an earlier passage. I spoke little but felt more willing to continue than on the first visit.

lines.zh: 有人问我是不是这个新安排把我变得会说了。我觉得这么说太快。我第一次不说，也和那天没读完有关；第三次选的书我更熟悉，朋友也坐在旁边。新安排给了我准备时间，这一点有帮助，却不是只有一个原因。以后换一本难的，我可能仍然先听，不代表这几次参加都白费了。
lines.py: yǒu rén wèn wǒ shì bú shì zhè gè xīn ān pái bǎ wǒ biàn de huì shuō le . wǒ jué de zhè me shuō tài kuài . wǒ dì yī cì bù shuō , yě hé nà tiān méi dú wán yǒu guān ; dì sān cì xuǎn de shū wǒ gèng shú xī , péng you yě zuò zài páng biān . xīn ān pái gěi le wǒ zhǔn bèi shí jiān , zhè yī diǎn yǒu bāng zhù , què bù shì zhǐ yǒu yī gè yuán yīn . yǐ hòu huàn yī běn nán de , wǒ kě néng réng rán xiān tīng , bù dài biǎo zhè jǐ cì cān jiā dōu bái fèi le .
lines.en: I resisted attributing my speaking entirely to the new arrangement. Unfinished reading, greater familiarity with the third book and a friend beside me also mattered. Preparation time helped but was not the sole cause. Listening first to a difficult future book wouldn’t erase the value of previous participation.

lines.zh: 我参加的时候，发现大家年龄不同。有一位朋友说年轻人都爱看快的故事，我正好喜欢读得慢一点，就告诉他自己的选择。他听了笑，说他自己也常常跳过不喜欢的地方。我们后来没有继续替所有年轻人和年长的人下结论，而是聊这一本哪里想慢慢看，哪里读过就想往下走。
lines.py: wǒ cān jiā de shí hou , fā xiàn dà jiā nián líng bù tóng . yǒu yī wèi péng you shuō nián qīng rén dōu ài kàn kuài de gù shì , wǒ zhèng hǎo xǐ huān dú de màn yī diǎn , jiù gào sù tā zì jǐ de xuǎn zé . tā tīng le xiào , shuō tā zì jǐ yě cháng cháng tiào guò bù xǐ huān de dì fāng . wǒ men hòu lái méi yǒu jì xù tì suǒ yǒu nián qīng rén hé nián zhǎng de rén xià jié lùn , ér shì liáo zhè yī běn nǎ lǐ xiǎng màn màn kàn , nǎ lǐ dú guò jiù xiǎng wǎng xià zǒu .
lines.en: A participant generalised that young people liked fast stories. I preferred reading slowly and said so; he admitted skipping parts himself. We moved from age generalisations to which parts of this book each wanted to savour or move past.

lines.zh: 最近通知发得频繁，我有一次看见书名，以为时间和以前相同，到了以后才发现那周晚了半小时。负责的人后来把每周安排放在一条消息里，改时间再单独发。我把最重要的日期记下来，感觉比原来容易找。这是我自己的情况，另一个朋友仍然喜欢早点收到书名，方便先借到书。
lines.py: zuì jìn tōng zhī fā de pín fán , wǒ yǒu yī cì kàn jiàn shū míng , yǐ wéi shí jiān hé yǐ qián xiāng tóng , dào le yǐ hòu cái fā xiàn nà zhōu wǎn le bàn xiǎo shí . fù zé de rén hòu lái bǎ měi zhōu ān pái fàng zài yī tiáo xiāo xī lǐ , gǎi shí jiān zài dān dú fā . wǒ bǎ zuì zhòng yào de rì qī jì xià lái , gǎn jué bǐ yuán lái róng yì zhǎo . zhè shì wǒ zì jǐ de qíng kuàng , lìng yī gè péng you réng rán xǐ huān zǎo diǎn shōu dào shū míng , fāng biàn xiān jiè dào shū .
lines.en: Frequent notices led me once to assume the usual time and miss a half-hour delay. A consolidated weekly message with separate time-change notices helped me find the essentials. That was my experience; another friend preferred earlier book-title notice to arrange borrowing.

lines.zh: 我们把两个需要都告诉她。她拿出本子记下来，说下一本书名放在这周消息的最后，下周的时间和地点仍然一起发。朋友说这样就能先去借书，我也不用一条条找日期。她问我们愿不愿意帮忙看一下消息清不清楚，我们答应了。下一周收到时，朋友马上回她书已经借到，我把日期放进日历，还在旁边记了小厅的位置。
lines.py: wǒ men bǎ liǎng gè xū yào dōu gào sù tā . tā ná chū běn zi jì xià lái , shuō xià yī běn shū míng fàng zài zhè zhōu xiāo xī de zuì hòu , xià zhōu de shí jiān hé dì diǎn réng rán yì qǐ fā . péng you shuō zhè yàng jiù néng xiān qù jiè shū , wǒ yě bù yòng yī tiáo tiáo zhǎo rì qī . tā wèn wǒ men yuàn bù yuàn yì bāng máng kàn yī xià xiāo xī qīng bù qīng chǔ , wǒ men dā yìng le . xià yī zhōu shōu dào shí , péng you mǎ shàng huí tā shū yǐ jīng jiè dào , wǒ bǎ rì qī fàng jìn rì lì , hái zài páng biān jì le xiǎo tīng de wèi zhì .
lines.en: We told her both needs. She noted them: the next title would go at the end of this week's message; next week's time and place would still arrive together. My friend could borrow the book early, and I could find the date easily. We agreed to check whether the message was clear. The following week he replied that he'd borrowed it; I added the date and small hall to my calendar.

lines.zh: 我现在偶尔来，也会错过几周。再回来时，有人记得我的名字，有人是第一次见。我希望小组继续，但不希望负责的人只能看人数来判断自己的努力。对我来说，能在准备好一句话以后开口，别人愿意耐心听，这已经是很具体的收获。是不是以后每周都来，还要看我的时间，不必现在就作出一个永远不变的答应。
lines.py: wǒ xiàn zài ǒu ěr lái , yě huì cuò guò jǐ zhōu . zài huí lái shí , yǒu rén jì de wǒ de míng zi , yǒu rén shì dì yī cì jiàn . wǒ xī wàng xiǎo zǔ jì xù , dàn bù xī wàng fù zé de rén zhǐ néng kàn rén shù lái pàn duàn zì jǐ de nǔ lì . duì wǒ lái shuō , néng zài zhǔn bèi hǎo yī jù huà yǐ hòu kāi kǒu , bié ren yuàn yì nài xīn tīng , zhè yǐ jīng shì hěn jù tǐ de shōu huò . shì bú shì yǐ hòu měi zhōu dōu lái , hái yào kàn wǒ de shí jiān , bù bì xiàn zài jiù zuò chū yī gè yǒng yuǎn bù biàn de dā yìng .
lines.en: I attend occasionally and miss weeks. Returning brings both familiar and new people. I hope the group continues without the organiser judging effort only by attendance. Being able to offer one prepared sentence and receive patient attention is a concrete benefit. Weekly future attendance still depends on my availability, without an eternal promise now.

turns.pinyin: tōng zhī shǎo fā yī diǎn , shì bú shì bù lián luò le ?
turns.meaning: Do fewer notices mean no contact?
examples: 不是，一周发一次，改时间再单独联络。
accept: ^不是，一周发一次，改时间再单独联络。[。！？]?$

pragmatics.situation: Ask about a claim without asserting it

natural.zh: 你说人数多了，大家的感受也变了吗？
natural.py: nǐ shuō rén shù duō le , dà jiā de gǎn shòu yě biàn le ma ?
natural.en: You said attendance increased; did people’s experience change too?

pragmatics.note: Leave the answer open rather than treating a count as an attitude.

natural.zh: 能不能讲一次具体的情况？
natural.py: néng bù néng jiǎng yī cì jù tǐ de qíng kuàng ?
natural.en: Could you describe a particular occasion?

pragmatics.note: Request an example without requiring it to stand for everyone.

natural.zh: 她说这个办法对一些人有帮助。
natural.py: tā shuō zhè gè bàn fǎ duì yī xiē rén yǒu bāng zhù .
natural.en: She says this approach helped some people.

pragmatics.note: Some is not all; the statement remains attributed.

audio.zh: 没有，先试六周。第一次六个人，上周十个人。
audio.py: méi yǒu , xiān shì liù zhōu . dì yī cì liù gè rén , shàng zhōu shí gè rén .
audio.en: No, we started with a six-week trial. Six people came first time, ten last week.

tasks.statement: Ten people attended the very first meeting.
tasks.why: Six attended first; ten attended last week.

audio.zh: 也不能这么说。有人还是怕讲错，我会先问他想不想说一句。
audio.py: yě bù néng zhè me shuō . yǒu rén hái shi pà jiǎng cuò , wǒ huì xiān wèn tā xiǎng bù xiǎng shuō yī jù .
audio.en: Not necessarily. Some still fear mistakes; I ask whether they’d like to start with one sentence.

tasks.statement: The organiser says some still fear mistakes.
tasks.why: The qualification explicitly keeps that concern.

audio.zh: 接下来，她想改的是通知。我听见“联络更方便”，以为要发更多消息，她说正好相反。近来日期、书名、准备事项分开发，有人找不到最重要的一条。她准备一周发一次完整安排，如果时间更换，再单独通知。少发并不等于不联络，而是让同一个人不用在几条消息里来回找。
audio.py: jiē xià lái , tā xiǎng gǎi de shì tōng zhī . wǒ tīng jiàn lián luò gèng fāng biàn , yǐ wéi yào fā gèng duō xiāo xī , tā shuō zhèng hǎo xiāng fǎn . jìn lái rì qī , shū míng , zhǔn bèi shì xiàng fēn kāi fā , yǒu rén zhǎo bù dào zuì zhòng yào de yī tiáo . tā zhǔn bèi yī zhōu fā yī cì wán zhěng ān pái , rú guǒ shí jiān gēng huàn , zài dān dú tōng zhī . shǎo fā bìng bù děng yú bù lián luò , ér shì ràng tóng yī gè rén bù yòng zài jǐ tiáo xiāo xī lǐ lái huí zhǎo .
audio.en: Her next change concerned notices. I assumed easier contact meant more messages; she meant the opposite. Dates, titles and preparations had been sent separately, obscuring the key information. One weekly complete schedule plus separate updates for changed times would reduce searching without ending contact.

tasks.statement: The organiser plans unlimited individual reminders.
tasks.why: One complete weekly message and time-change updates are proposed.

audio.zh: 有人问我是不是这个新安排把我变得会说了。我觉得这么说太快。我第一次不说，也和那天没读完有关；第三次选的书我更熟悉，朋友也坐在旁边。新安排给了我准备时间，这一点有帮助，却不是只有一个原因。以后换一本难的，我可能仍然先听，不代表这几次参加都白费了。
audio.py: yǒu rén wèn wǒ shì bú shì zhè gè xīn ān pái bǎ wǒ biàn de huì shuō le . wǒ jué de zhè me shuō tài kuài . wǒ dì yī cì bù shuō , yě hé nà tiān méi dú wán yǒu guān ; dì sān cì xuǎn de shū wǒ gèng shú xī , péng you yě zuò zài páng biān . xīn ān pái gěi le wǒ zhǔn bèi shí jiān , zhè yī diǎn yǒu bāng zhù , què bù shì zhǐ yǒu yī gè yuán yīn . yǐ hòu huàn yī běn nán de , wǒ kě néng réng rán xiān tīng , bù dài biǎo zhè jǐ cì cān jiā dōu bái fèi le .
audio.en: I resisted attributing my speaking entirely to the new arrangement. Unfinished reading, greater familiarity with the third book and a friend beside me also mattered. Preparation time helped but was not the sole cause. Listening first to a difficult future book wouldn’t erase the value of previous participation.

tasks.statement: The participant identifies more than one helpful circumstance.
tasks.why: Preparation, familiarity and a friend beside them all matter.

prompt.zh: 第一次六个人，上周十个人。第一次有几个人？
prompt.py: dì yī cì liù gè rén , shàng zhōu shí gè rén . dì yī cì yǒu jǐ gè rén ?
prompt.en: Six came first time, ten last week. How many came first time?

choices: 六个。
十个。
两次都是十个。
tasks.why: Keep first and last week distinct.

prompt.zh: 我还不知道他们会不会再来。你能确定下周人数吗？
prompt.py: wǒ hái bù zhī dào tā men huì bù huì zài lái . nǐ néng què dìng xià zhōu rén shù ma ?
prompt.en: I don’t yet know whether they will return. Can you determine next week’s attendance?

choices: 不能，先问有没有空。
能，一定还是十个。
能，一定没有人来。
tasks.why: Uncertainty is not either extreme prediction.

prompt.zh: 先听，再决定要不要说。现在必须答应发言吗？
prompt.py: xiān tīng , zài jué dìng yào bù yào shuō . xiàn zài bì xū dā yìng fā yán ma ?
prompt.en: Listen first, then decide whether to speak. Must a speech be promised now?

choices: 不用，可以先听。
必须，先听就是已经答应说。
必须，而且不能先听。

line.zh: 读半小时，【加上】交流半小时，一共一个小时。
line.py: dú bàn xiǎo shí , jiā shàng jiāo liú bàn xiǎo shí , yī gòng yī gè xiǎo shí .
line.en: Half an hour reading plus half an hour discussion totals one hour.

line.zh: 【近来】每次来的人比刚开始多。
line.py: jìn lái měi cì lái de rén bǐ gāng kāi shǐ duō .
line.en: Recently attendance has been higher than at the beginning.

line.zh: 只凭人数，【难以】知道大家喜欢什么。
line.py: zhǐ píng rén shù , nán yǐ zhī dào dà jiā xǐ huān shén me .
line.en: Numbers alone make it hard to know what people like.

right.py: wǒ dì yī cì jiē chù zhè gè dú shū xiǎo zǔ , shì péng you dài wǒ lái de .
right.en: My first contact with this reading group was through a friend.

right.py: yǒu rén zhǎo bù dào yè , wǒ men nài xīn děng tā yī xià .

right.py: rén duō yǐ hòu , shéi xiān shuō zhè gè wèn tí yì zhí kùn rǎo wǒ .
right.en: As attendance grew, deciding who speaks first kept troubling me.

right.py: liǎng zhāng piào jiā shàng chē fèi , chāo guò le wǒ de yù suàn .
right.en: The two tickets plus travel cost exceed my budget.

right.py: mén huài le , wū lǐ de rén nán yǐ chū qù .
right.en: The broken door makes it difficult for those inside to get out.

right.py: wǒ men tóng yì bāng máng , qián tí shì xiān shuō qīng rì qī .
right.en: We agree to help provided the date is clarified first.

pairs.left: I disagree with the view that not speaking means not participating.

right.zh: 我不太同意“没说话就是没参加”这个说法。
right.py: wǒ bù tài tóng yì méi shuō huà jiù shì méi cān jiā zhè gè shuō fǎ .
right.en: I disagree with the view that not speaking means not participating.

pairs.left: Recent contact was too frequent; someone wanted just one notification.

right.zh: 最近联络太频繁，有人希望只收一次通知。
right.py: zuì jìn lián luò tài pín fán , yǒu rén xī wàng zhǐ shōu yī cì tōng zhī .
right.en: Recent contact was too frequent; someone wanted just one notification.

right.en: This letter asks whether one can listen first and decide later whether to speak.

notes:
2026-10-07 advanced media/social core. Original AI-assisted draft, checked against the stated inventory and comprehension keys. Native review pending. This is a selected competency route; it does not certify full HSK lexical coverage, exam readiness or learner mastery. Native review: shoulder teasing, interview register and the precise force of 凭/难以. Self-review separates six-week trial from ongoing attendance, first-six from last-ten, one-hour participant session from organiser preparation, and attributed experience from universal effectiveness. Age generalisations are challenged through concrete preferences, not replaced by another stereotype. Twenty-four word introductions are context-selected; earlier known interview language remains retrieval. No actual study or participation statistic is implied.
2026-10-08 advanced reading self-review: Three-person soup dialogue keeps distinct speaker IDs but loses the blanket skill judgment and consent explanation. Readings show initial confusion, an actual request to stop, apology, the cook’s own bowl joke and sincere enjoyment at home. Newcomer still asks not to be called 傻; no universal irony rule is taught. Interview/weekly notice and five-classmate survey remain evidence-bound text types. Short/full video distinction and misheard light/letters facts retained. Native flags: 汤救回来, salt-bowl comeback, X什么X strength and friendly mainland banter. Native review pending.
